components.name: Encapsulation Mold Compound

components.name: Ball Grid Array (BGA) Solder Balls

components.name: Thermal Interface Material (TIM)
components.reasoning: Material applied between the die and the package heat spreader to improve thermal conduction; often procured separately though sometimes integrated, making it moderately confident as a separate component.

components.name: Heat Spreader/Heat Sink
components.reasoning: A metallic plate or component attached for heat dissipation from the package; used commonly but design-dependent, so it may be integrated or separate.

components.name: Underfill Adhesive
components.reasoning: Encapsulant applied under the die between substrate and die to enhance mechanical strength and reliability; often procured separately, but integrated in some processes.
